# discord_server_widget (Data Source)

Reads the public widget data of a server, as shown by the server widget. The widget must be enabled, for example with the `discord_server_widget` resource. Reading it creates an invite when the widget has an invite channel and no invite exists yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_server_widget" "main" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  enabled   = true
}

data "discord_server_widget" "main" {
  server_id  = var.server_id
  depends_on = [discord_server_widget.main]
}

output "online_members" {
  value = data.discord_server_widget.main.presence_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) Voice and stage channels that @everyone can join. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `instant_invite` (String) Invite URL for the widget's invite channel, or null when none is set.
- `members` (Attributes List) Online members, at most 100. Discord anonymizes their IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `presence_count` (Number) Number of online members.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `position` (Number) Sort position.


<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) Avatar URL.
- `id` (String) Anonymized member ID.
- `status` (String) Presence status, such as `online` or `idle`.
- `username` (String) Username.
